caption_draft:
Your first app can use these 6 free APIs today.

Open-Meteo — https://open-meteo.com/ — 10,000 free calls a day
PokeAPI — https://pokeapi.co/docs/v2 — No API key needed
NASA APOD — https://api.nasa.gov/ — Works with DEMO_KEY
JokeAPI — https://v2.jokeapi.dev/ — No sign-up or payment
Dog API — https://dog.ceo/dog-api/ — 20,000+ dog photos
Open Library — https://openlibrary.org/developers/api — Book data in JSON

Save this for your next project and send it to the friend who is starting their first app.

#firstapp #api #webdev #coding #firstyear #internship #javascript #python #notyourcollege
